newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus removes duties on 30,000 T Ukraine sugar.
newsitem.headline: Belarus removes duties on 30,000 T Ukraine sugar.

text.p: Belarus President Alexander Lukashenko has removed import duties on 30,000 tonnes of Ukrainian sugar, vice-premier Vasily Dolgolov said on Friday.
"The result of this is the price of white sugar from Ukraine will be lower than the price of Belarus white sugar made from imported raws," Dolgolov said.
The sugar was purchased under contract by state concern Belbakalyeya.

Belarus, which announced this week that it planned to double its refined sugar import duties to 20 percent starting March 19, is trying to fill domestic needs until it finishes processing 260,000 tonnes of raw sugar recently imported from Brazil.
Dolgolov said that two shiploads of Brazilian raws had been unloaded, and that the former Soviet republic's four refineries were producing 3,000 tonnes daily.
Ukraine has been a traditional sugar exporter to Belarus.
Belarus's 1996 sugar beet harvest was one million tonnes, below 1995's 1.14 million.
